reviews.title: Review of Google Maps
reviews.pros:
1. Easy to find locations, directions, etc.

2. Great navigation implementation

3. Nice user interface and map options

4. Doesn't use a lot of data
reviews.cons: Sometimes roads closed due to construction are not factored into directions, but there's only so much you can do.
reviews.overall: Overall I love this app, I use it on a daily basis, and its very easy to use! I also like how it doesn't use a lot of mobile data.

reviews.title: The best navigation tool ever
reviews.pros: It is versatile tool It most certainly helps in making the route simpler. It gives us headings to the spots we couldn't ever have figured how we could arrive. You don't need to recollect the headings at all since it does the work for you! It likewise monitors your pattern. It provides you the route for all modes of convenience.
reviews.cons: Like any other applications, there are frequently some minor errors and rerouting that can be disappointing while at the same time depending on this gadget. In any case, nothing some persistence can't help.
reviews.overall: Google maps is an extremely quick and basic approach to see various objections and courses to follow, it is exceptionally down to earth and instinctive, it permits me to impart guides to my companions, which makes it simple ordinarily to discover ourselves and go out to visit places, I would prescribe it to anybody.

reviews.title: A service worth paying for!
reviews.pros: - Google Maps provide a life-changing service for free of cost. It has literally set the standard for navigation software enabling billions of people around the world with such great technology.
reviews.cons: - Everything on Google Maps isn't always vetted. There have been situations where I was taken to a completely different place from what I was looking for.
reviews.overall: Navigation is one of the most essential aspects of today's life. without it, we're lost in this huge world. Google Maps are providing such an important service for free.

reviews.title: Don't  Like the Layout
reviews.pros: It is convenient to use mainly because business and attraction addresses you find on Google open directly onto Google Maps.
reviews.cons: I hate the layout. I feel as if the arrow is going backwards, where as Apple Maps and Waze it is going forwards. I also dislike how 2D the format feels.
reviews.overall: It works, and is convenient when using Google itself, but I prefer Apple Maps because of the format and layout.

reviews.title: Internet's default map service
reviews.pros:
Smooth interface.

Shows landmarks and important places.

Excellent navigation feature.

Reliable.

Offline usage by downloading map of an area.

Multi-lingual support.
reviews.cons:
Some routes may be blocked or out of order.

Facing direction is not accurate sometimes.
reviews.overall: Google Map is the 'default' map of Internet due to its excellent API which can be well integrated into any website or app. It is really easy to use and accessible.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.pros: Google maps is my favorite to use because it includes everything in one place including important business info.
reviews.cons: Not much I can say that I dislike about Google maps.
reviews.overall: Overall I think it's better than apple maps in many ways because of how it incorporates business information.
